paragraphs.text: Lolth is a black -aligned deity from the Forgotten Realms , featured in Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms . Though depicted on a planeswalker card, Lolth is not a planeswalker within Magic lore.

Lolth is the goddess of the drows and spiders . She can take the form of a beautiful drow woman, a hideous spider of monstrous proportions, or more commonly a drider (a drow whose lower torso is that of a monstrous spider).
Unlike planeswalkers in Magic lore, as a D&D character, she does not have a planeswalker's spark .
